name: Administrative interface
summary: Every entity in the system, including manifest-declared client entities, gets an admin surface automatically. This is the largest single reason client-specific entities belong in the manifest rather than in code: declaring one buys admin, audit, search, permissions, and reporting with no further work.

requires.reason: Admin is generated from the entity registry.
Admin composes kernel components and tokens.

exposes.name: AdminConsole
exposes.description: Auto-generated CRUD, search, filter, and export for every registered entity.

exposes.name: entityDisplay
exposes.description: Per-entity display configuration contributed by capabilities: column selection, labels, and detail layout.

exposes.name: bulkActions
exposes.description: Bulk actions contributed by capabilities and surfaced on the relevant entity list.

slots.name: customAdminView
slots.when: when an entity's admin view is resolved
slots.description: Replaces the generated view for a specific entity with a client-specific one.

slots.name: entityDisplayConfig
slots.when: when admin columns and labels are resolved
slots.description: Client-specific column selection, ordering, and labelling.

slots.name: bulkAction
slots.when: when the bulk action menu is built

smoke.name: every registered entity has an admin surface
smoke.asserts: each entity in the registry, including manifest-declared ones, resolves a list and a detail view

smoke.name: admin is permission-gated
smoke.asserts: a user without admin.access receives 403 on every admin route

templates.description: Admin registration for every entity in the resolved graph.
